## North Star transfer, scope and obligations
Durable identity may strengthen how a character responds to an obligation while
that obligation's existence remains a separate, finite fact. Retirement should
remove its motive, not remove the character's identity. Recurrence is a new concrete
instance, and other characters know only what they were permitted to observe.

## Earned identity is held fixed, not replaced by an authored trait
The prelude executes actual reasons, addressed choice, frozen expression and
qualification, then appends the accepted quantized contribution to identity414.
All four models share that exact contribution and every subsequent probe retains
the identical history. K1/100 and modifier unit1/10 deliberately expose strong
standing+3. That is a receiving calibration, not a claim about learning speed.
Probe decisions are Auto when a live option exists; no further identity updates
occur. The experiment tests persistent identity versus changing motive existence,
not new general identity reinforcement, coercion or biography laws.

## Lifecycle is causal rather than retroactive
Command source30 schedules the owner transition at140. The decision at40..80 and
truthful communication at110 use the prior committed instance status. Cancellation
therefore first removes pressure on the next instant. A recipient can correctly
observe Active before cancellation and later hold a stale Active belief; the
observer must receive a retirement message to update it. The implementation does
not silently synchronize belief to private state when retirement commits.
